request_user:
Fact: target_systems
What to find: Type and nature of AI systems the model can be integrated into (e.g. assistants, agents, RAG, decision support).
Card sections that often contain it: Intended Use, Use Cases, Downstream Use

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Instruction tuned models are intended for assistant-like chat and visual reasoning tasks; also usable for natural language generation (pretrained), visual recognition, image reasoning, captioning, image Q&A, and synthetic data generation and distillation to improve other models. Should be deployed as part of an overall AI system with additional guardrails.
quotes: Instruction tuned models are intended for assistant-like chat and visual reasoning tasks, whereas pretrained models can be adapted for natural language generation.
The Llama 4 model collection also supports the ability to leverage the outputs of its models to improve other models including synthetic data generation and distillation.
Large language models, including Llama 4, are not designed to be deployed in isolation but instead should be deployed as part of an overall AI system with additional guardrails as required.
